name: physicsos
description: PhysicsOS - verified physics visualization and Agent platform on DeepSeek Harness

scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:web
scripts.build:web: pnpm run build:agent && pnpm run build:hosts && pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-physicsos run bundle && pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:core && pnpm run typecheck:web && pnpm run typecheck:agent
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:core && pnpm run lint:web && pnpm run lint:agent
scripts.lint:web: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness exec oxlint packages/client/ui-physicsos/src packages/client/ui-physicsos/tests
scripts.lint:agent: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness exec oxlint packages/physicsos/tool-physicsos/src packages/physicsos/tool-physicsos/tests packages/physicsos/auth-host/src packages/physicsos/auth-host/tests packages/physicsos/paper-host/src packages/physicsos/paper-host/tests packages/physicsos/notice-host/src packages/physicsos/notice-host/tests packages/physicsos/update-host/src packages/physicsos/update-host/tests packages/physicsos/health-host/src packages/physicsos/health-host/tests packages/physicsos/learning-host/src packages/physicsos/learning-host/tests packages/physicsos/class-host/src packages/physicsos/class-host/tests packages/physicsos/shared-state-host/src packages/physicsos/shared-state-host/tests packages/physicsos/ops-host/src packages/physicsos/ops-host/tests packages/physicsos/plugin-center/src packages/physicsos/plugin-center/tests packages/physicsos/model-pool-host/src packages/physicsos/model-pool-host/tests packages/storage/storage-postgres/src packages/storage/storage-postgres/tests
scripts.test: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:web && pnpm run test:agent && pnpm run test:deploy && pnpm run test:desktop
scripts.test:web: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness exec vitest run packages/client/ui-physicsos/tests
scripts.test:agent: pnpm -C vendor/deepseek-harness exec vitest run packages/physicsos
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
